messages:
Asha: hypothetical quick one — you can only eat ONE thing (meal or snack) for 7 days straight. what do you pick? No swaps, no cheat days. go.
Ben: pizza. obviously. whole pies every day. :pizza:
Mina: ramen. instant counts, and you can add stuff. comfort for a week.
Asha: instant ramen + toppings allowed? that feels like a loophole :thinking_face:
Mina: yep, toppings allowed. it's still ramen.
Ravi: burrito bowl. rice + beans + salsa = a civilization.
Sam: avocado toast. healthy(ish) and portable. :avocado:
Taylor: rotisserie chicken. protein for days and good leftovers.
Kai: instant noodles + egg. cheap, fast, mood lifter.
Ben: also, will pizza get boring? maybe, but can switch toppings.
Asha: tiny poll — drop one emoji for your pick and i'll tally in a minute.
Ben: :pizza:
Mina: :ramen:
Ravi: :burrito:
Sam: :avocado:
Taylor: :chicken:
Kai: :ramen:
Asha: tally so far — pizza 1, ramen 2, burrito 1, avocado 1, chicken 1. surprising ramen swing.
Sam: i'd accept ramen if we call it "elevated ramen" each night with herbs.
Mina: don't @ me for loving cup noodles, it's a lifestyle. :grin:
ops-bot: Heads up — free lunch in the kitchen this Friday: rotisserie chicken confirmed. :information_source:
Asha: perfect alignment with this thread :tada:
